name: octopus-mate
description: OctopusMate: AI transformation consulting mate — transformation vision building via the Octopus 7-Step and North Star metric methods, VITAL five-dimension status diagnosis (22 angles, 1-5 scoring, blocker identification), and enterprise capability roadmap building (six stages, deliverable package), all driven by a shared method engine with file-level gates and user-strong-confirmation; direction and authorization always decided by the consultant.

displayDescription.en: Consulting mate for AI transformation advisors: vision building, VITAL five-dimension status diagnosis, roadmap, delivery and reporting — direction always decided by the consultant.
displayDescription.zh: 给 AI 转型咨询顾问当大副：愿景构建、VITAL 五维现状诊断、路线图与汇报全链路搭手，方向由顾问拍板。
